header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners nor any intimation is received. The
body: petition was filed in the 2021 and lastly fixed on 18.11.2024 in Court. Today learned A.A.G submits that road for which this petition was filed has now been constructed and completed. In view of such statement, the instant petition stands disposed of being infructuous.
